data.text:
The satellite loop of Tropical Storm Penha (Basyang)’s multiple, wintertime landfalls in the southern Philippines over the last 24 hours, which have left at least 8 casualties and 28,000 displaced.

This area of the archipelago is notorious for being vulnerable to cyclonically-induced landslides and flooding, which is why we’ve seen significant damage even though Penga is just a 1,000 mbar storm.
